function: Dual-functional constant-modulus ISAC waveform and STAR-RIS reflection/transmission coefficient design minimizing weighted MUI energy and waveform discrepancy; the learned part (TD3) handles coupled phase shifts (p. 3, 8).
system: ISAC-BS 10-antenna ULA, 1 target, 4 single-antenna users, STAR-RIS (simultaneously transmitting and reflecting, energy splitting) with 20 elements (40 for TD3 figures); normalized carrier (p. 3, 10, 12).
method: TD3 deep reinforcement learning (fully connected actor and critic, 512 neurons) for coupled phase shifts, trained by trial and error on a reward; the independent-phase case uses non-learned ADMM (p. 8-10).
data_channel: Own simulator: Gaussian channel coefficients, small-scale fading only, QPSK symbols; the TD3 agent interacts with this environment, no dataset (p. 10-11).
test_conditions: TD3 trained and evaluated on a snapshot channel, 4,000 episodes; convergence compared over learning rates and four channels; no unseen test condition (p. 10-13).
baselines: TD3 versus learned SAC and DDPG on reward and beampattern; non-learned ES, CRIS, TS, PDD benchmark only the non-learned ADMM scheme (p. 11-13).
metrics: TD3: cumulative reward and beampattern versus radar-only reference; ADMM scheme: detection probability, achievable rate, BER, convergence (p. 11-13).
complexity: Order of complexity given for TD3 (eq. 41, p. 10) and for ADMM (eq. 29, p. 7); no runtime or operation counts.
q1_support: p. 10: "all channel coefficients are assumed to follow Gaussian distributions"; custom simulator, small-scale fading only, no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "while the other results focus on a snapshot of a particular channel realization"; Fig. 13 (p. 13) compares TD3 training convergence over channels, not a trained model in new conditions.
q3_support: p. 13: "we consider the widely adopted soft actor critic (SAC) and deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) algorithms as benchmarks"; no non-learned method is compared with TD3, ES, CRIS, TS, PDD (p. 11) serve only ADMM.
q4_support: p. 10: "the computational complexity of TD3 algorithm can be formulated as"; eq. (41) gives its order.
q5_support: p. 11: "averaging over 1000 independent random channel realizations"; simulated data, no link to code or data in the paper.
notes: The paper proposes an ADMM scheme (independent phase shifts, not learned) and a TD3 scheme (coupled phase shifts, learned); the learned part is graded. Area 5 (ISAC waveform) wins over area 3. q3 is 0 because Figs. 6-9 (p. 11-12) compare only the ADMM scheme with non-learned ES, CRIS, TS, PDD, while the TD3 scheme (Figs. 10-13, p. 12-13) is compared only with SAC and DDPG and with the radar-only reference waveform, a target and not a competing method. Tables I, II and figure legends read from page images (p. 3, 10, 12, 13).
